title.zh: SATA、ATA 命令集与 AHCI 的分层
title.en: SATA Layers: Wire, ATA Commands and AHCI

description.zh: SATA 只管线和帧，命令来自 T13 的 ATA 命令集，主机这边的寄存器接口是 Intel 的 AHCI；M.2 是插槽形状，不是协议。
description.en: SATA defines the wire and the frames; the commands come from T13's ATA set and the host-side register interface is Intel's AHCI. M.2 is a slot shape, not a protocol.

zh: BIOS 里的 AHCI 模式是什么

title.zh: 并行 ATA 为什么跑不快：时序预算与线间偏斜
title.en: Why Parallel ATA Topped Out: Timing Budget and Skew

description.zh: Ultra DMA 6 每 15 ns 交出一次数据，建立、保持和线间偏斜要挤进同一个窗口；串行链路把时钟藏进数据里，偏斜问题就没了。
description.en: Ultra DMA 6 hands over data every 15 ns, and setup, hold and wire-to-wire skew must fit in that window. A serial link hides the clock in the data, so skew stops mattering.

zh: 为什么并行总线被串行取代

description.zh: 每 8 位变 10 位：连续相同的位不超过 5 个、0 和 1 的累计差不超过 ±1，K28.5 里的逗号让接收端对齐字节。6 Gb/s 因此只剩 600 MB/s。
description.en: Each byte becomes 10 bits: no more than five equal bits in a row, a running disparity held to ±1, and a comma in K28.5 so the receiver can find byte edges. That is why 6 Gb/s carries 600 MB/s.

title.zh: FIS 帧：一条读命令在线上的样子
title.en: FIS Frames: One Read Command on the Wire

description.zh: READ FPDMA QUEUED 走五种帧：主机发命令，盘回应、发 DMA Setup、送数据、最后用 Set Device Bits 报完成；每帧有原语握手、CRC 和加扰。
description.en: A READ FPDMA QUEUED uses five frame types: command, register reply, DMA Setup, data, and Set Device Bits for completion, each wrapped in primitive handshakes, a CRC and scrambling.

title.en: NCQ: Letting a Hard Disk Reorder Its Queue

description.zh: 最多 32 条命令交给盘，盘按寻道加旋转的总时间挑下一条；模型里深度 16 的随机读比按到达顺序快一倍左右。
description.en: Up to 32 commands are handed to the drive, which picks the next one by seek plus rotation time. In the model, random reads at depth 16 run about twice as fast as first-come order.

zh: 电梯算法 磁盘调度

title.en: Hot Plug and Link Power: Partial, Slumber, DevSleep

description.zh: 睡得越深醒得越慢：三种状态的唤醒上限是 10 µs、10 ms 和 20 ms。空闲多长才值得睡，取决于省下的功率和醒来的代价。
description.en: Deeper sleep wakes slower: the exit limits are 10 µs, 10 ms and 20 ms. Whether a gap is long enough to sleep through depends on the power saved against the cost of waking.

zh: 笔记本固态硬盘待机功耗

title.zh: 端口倍增器、eSATA、mSATA 与 M.2 SATA
title.en: Port Multipliers, eSATA, mSATA and M.2 SATA

description.zh: 一个口最多挂 15 块盘，但按命令切换时同一时间只有一块在干活；eSATA、mSATA、M.2 改的是线和插头，协议没变。
description.en: One port can fan out to 15 drives, but with command-based switching only one works at a time. eSATA, mSATA and M.2 change the cable and connector, not the protocol.

zh: 一个 SATA 口接多块硬盘

title.zh: 为什么 SATA 停在 6 Gb/s

description.zh: 最快的 SATA 固态盘已经顶到链路，而机械盘外圈只有约 285 MB/s，离 6 Gb/s 还差一半；固态盘改走 PCIe，SATA 留给机械盘。
description.en: The fastest SATA SSDs already hit the link, while a hard disk's outer edge reads about 285 MB/s, half of 6 Gb/s. SSDs moved to PCIe and SATA stayed with spinning disks.

zh: 机械硬盘需要更快的接口吗
en: do hard drives need a faster interface

title.zh: SATA 的前沿（截至 2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: 规范最后一版是 2021 年的 3.5a；44 TB 机械盘已经出货，多路并行读和 NVMe 机械盘是下一步要看的。
description.en: The last revision is 3.5a from 2021; 44 TB hard drives ship, and parallel-read heads and NVMe hard drives are what to watch next.
